title: Christmas movie fondue (red Meltie mug, christmas table) — restage 04
notes: Restage 04 of shorts/Su66AMPolD0 ("you + me?"): RED variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), the treats on the oak dining table with a green garland runner (an oak dining table with a green pine garland runner and gold candlesticks in a dining room at night, a sideboard with candles and a lit garland behind) instead of the white desk in front of a red curtain and a Christmas tree. Table decor kept (gnome pumpkin, pumpkins, candle jar, laptop). Reworded hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose (brief). Laptop: generated fictional holiday-film stills (no children, no real film footage); plain unbranded red bag; Sora audio.
